generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)
Executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work (Cement Concrete - xxxx cum, Earthwork - xxxx cum, etc) (80% of peak rate of construction)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Owning the following key and critical equipment for this work (xxxx, xxxx, xxxx)
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Each tenderer in his name should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Operation and Maintenance of atleast one MVS in rural area/ one urban water supply scheme of value not less than Rs.xxxLakhs (usually not less than 50%of estimated value of contract for which tender is invited)
staff details as per bid document
Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Operation & Maintainance of Multi Village water supply scheme to Bidarahalli and other12 villages from in HD Kote taluk of Mysore District

itemList.description:
Operation & Maintainance of the scheme, which includes, providing technical staff, valve man, operators and others who are required to run the system in complete manner and providing all materials & chemicals required, for operation of 1) Regular maintainance of civil structures like Intakewell, Jackwell , WTP, PWS, Zonal Balancing Reservoirs Pump House and all other civil structures, cleaning and washing, etc., 2) Repairs and replacement of damaged pipeline, valves etc, if found necessary. It includes cost of materials and labour charges and also monitoring of the systems. The maintainance involves Raw Water rising main, Gravity mains, Pure Water rising mains.3) Operation and Maintainance of Water Treatment Plant including dosing of required quantity of alum, chlorine and other chemicals including replacement of filter media as required as per standard established norms from time to time maintaining. 4) Operation and Maintainance of all kinds of pumping machinery, other mechanical components of this scheme including electrical maintainance covering all repairs/replacement of transformes/Electrical cable/switch board/replacement of burnt parts etc.,All the above repairs & maintainance will be carried out as per the directions of the Engineer-Incharge for satisfactory functioning of the scheme to provide designed LPCD of drinking water to all the habitatants of the Project villages. NOTE : Helpers/Watchman/Valve man/Technical staff made available round the clock for maintainance period at Jackwell, WTP and Pure Water Sump points.1. The G.P or V.W.S.C/concerned Section Officer of the project should certify the satisfactory functioning of the scheme and based on this payments will be made to the contractor.2. The contractor should maintain a Log Book on the working of pumping machinery at Jackwell, WTP etc. I) 1st year Maintainance - Complete with all lead, lifts,labour, materials, loading, unloading and as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.
"The contractor should quote his rates excluding excise duty with the responsibility obtaining the re-embursement from excise department is lies with the contractor. The department is not responsible for obtaining any permissions"
